submitter: bugs_open/313 + bugs_open/298 — bugfix_313_internal_linker lane, session named bugs_open/313, owner-directed 2026-08-19. Both bugs filed by the bugfix_275_silent_row_caps lane, which closed 2026-08-19 leaving them explicitly unowned (who-owns.py verified; diagnosis queue empty).
rationale:
The internal linker has NEVER made a link in four months of completed jobs, and the cause is a two-line producer/consumer shape mismatch that is fully visible in config. `load_candidate_pages` declares output_format:'array', so QueryDatabaseAction returns a bare slice with no `count` key (database_actions.go:129); the very next step tests `candidate_pages.count > 0`; resolveFieldValue fails all five strategies against an array (strategy 5 requires a map, conditional_branch_action.go:402), ToFloat64(nil) fails, and the numeric arm returns false with no error (:283) — so every run since the agent's creation (2026-04-12) exits at complete_no_candidates, including a 2026-08-18 run holding FIFTEEN candidates in collected_data. plan_links, the agent's only LLM step, is downstream of the dead branch: llm_call_log for agent_type='internal-linker' has ZERO rows in all history (re-verified 2026-08-19). Diagnosis loop: CONFIRMED, first iteration (corr c4aa3559-86b1-4356-a28b-c71dfa661465, 2026-08-18). bugs_open/298 (the alphabetical LIMIT 15 on the same query) has consequently never shaped a link and goes LIVE the moment 313 is fixed — 8 of 26 sites exceed the cap today, worst 69 — which is why both are fixed in ONE migration, per 313's own ordering instruction.

THE CHANGE, three parts. (1) THIS BUG: migration 490 — output_format to 'object' (matching the working load_target_page/check_target_found pair two steps earlier in the same workflow); the prompt template's `{{range .candidate_pages}}` to `{{range .candidate_pages.rows}}` (the mandatory second half — ranging the new map yields columns/count/rows in key order, trading a dead branch for a broken prompt); the LIMIT 15 dropped with the 800-char truncation MARKED (' […truncated]', migration 446's remedy) — bounding the payload instead of the coverage, the shape the council approved for 275 (corr b684a399); and check_candidates opted into the new tripwire. Id-scoped, snapshot first, exact-text pre-state gate, DO/RAISE verify with controls, PLUS a PREPARE parse-check on the rewritten query — adopting the improvement debug_historian's round on migration 463 demonstrated (a position() check proves a needle, not that the SQL parses). (2) FRAMEWORK, config-time: config-key-audit --array-producer-conditions — flags any conditional dotting into a field whose every producer is an array-format query_database (explicit OR defaulted; database_actions.go:25 defaults to array). Uses validation.WalkSteps so nested substeps are covered (the bugs_open/144 32%-undercount class). Skips numeric indexes (WFA-012), unknown producers, and fields any object-format producer writes — it asserts 'can never resolve', not 'looks odd'. First live run: 191 agents, 145 conditionals, EXACTLY ONE finding = internal-linker.check_candidates, independently re-deriving 313's blast-radius census. (3) FRAMEWORK, run-time: opt-in `fail_on_non_numeric` on the conditional action — when set, a numeric comparison whose side fails ToFloat64 FAILS THE STEP naming the field, instead of silently routing to else_step. Deliberately scoped to the numeric operators only: for ==/!=/truthy a nil operand is a legitimate null probe (target_page.page_id != null); for > >= < < it is always a defect, and 313 is its measured cost.

SCOPE, argued not assumed (this council vetoed bugs_closed/124 on exactly this ground; WFA-009 is the approved precedent this follows). Owner 2026-07-29 §1: no shared guarantee changes — absent key preserves behaviour byte-for-byte, pinned by TestConditionalLenientDefaultStillRoutesToElse and mutation-proven (default flipped to true → RED; error arm disabled → fail-loud and AND-propagation tests RED; reverted, green). Owner 2026-08-02 §2: new authority on a shared seam ships as an opt-in field, unsafe default OFF — this is that field. RFC_022: all three conditions hold and the consumers are ENUMERATED, not asserted — fleet census 2026-08-19 (top-level AND nested, both action spellings): live conditional steps carry exactly condition/then_step/else_step, 145 uses each, so the ActionInputSpec registered in the same change is complete, not aspirational; exactly ONE config names the new key (internal-linker.check_candidates, via 490). The optional-key budget moves conditional from unregistered to 1 key against N=10. Concept-register entries (workflow-authoring, WFA-018/019) land in the same commit per the 2026-07-28 ruling condition 2. Config half: applying 490 before the Go halves roll is safe — unknown config keys are ignored at execution (bugs_open/101), so the flag is inert until the next chassis build ships the commit, and inert afterwards unless the path stops resolving again.

DELIBERATELY NOT DONE: teaching resolveFieldValue to synthesise .count for arrays (313 fix candidate 4 — it changes what every conditional in the fleet evaluates and would flip other always-false conditions to true in agents nobody is watching, for a measured affected set of ONE); ranking candidates by relevance (cosmetic once the cap is gone); wiring the new audit into the daily CronJob (the cron carries a Python mirror with its own parity contract — WFA-006 landmine; named as a follow-up decision rather than smuggled in).

plan.summary: Fix bugs_open/313 (internal-linker's check_candidates can never be true, so plan_links has never run) and bugs_open/298 (alphabetical LIMIT 15 on the same fetch) in one id-scoped, gated, parse-checked migration; close the class at config time with config-key-audit --array-producer-conditions (first live run: exactly the one motivating case across 145 conditionals); close it at run time with opt-in fail_on_non_numeric on the conditional action (default OFF, behaviour byte-for-byte unchanged when absent, mutation-proven), with the fixed step as its first and only consumer.

edits.rationale: The instance fix, all four config edits in one transaction so 313 and 298 cannot land separately in the wrong order (fixing the cap alone changes nothing observable; fixing the branch alone puts the cap live on 8 sites). 484's safety shape plus a PREPARE parse-check.
Restores the pre-490 state exactly (including, by design, 313's defect — a rollback restores, it does not pick a better state). Gated on 490's post-state so it cannot fire on the wrong row.

The run-time half. Opt-in fail_on_non_numeric read with GetBoolFieldLoud (WFA-010 — author-facing key). The exported evaluateStringCondition keeps its 3-arg lenient signature (two external test files call it); a Mode variant threads the flag through AND/OR recursion into the numeric arms only. Also registers the action's first ActionInputSpec, for both live names, ConfigKeys complete per fleet census, no CheckConfig/StrictConfig.

Pins both halves: the lenient default is FROZEN (the historical contract of 145 live steps), the flag fails the step naming the field, stays inert on resolvable comparisons in both outcomes, leaves null probes alone (the scope boundary), catches a non-numeric right side, propagates through AND, and the exported wrapper stays lenient. The two key guards are mutation-proven: default flipped → lenient test RED; error arm disabled → fail-loud + AND tests RED; reverted, green.

The config-time class-closer, as a new mode on the existing audit binary (the WFA-004/006/007/013 pattern — same registry, same WalkSteps traversal, refusal over an empty/broken export AND over zero decoded conditionals so a blind pass cannot read as clean). A finding requires that NO producer of the field could satisfy the path — the only version of 'can never be true' that survives a second producer being added.

The first fixture is the REAL pre-490 internal-linker shape with check_target_found as the in-workflow negative control (same idiom, object producer, must NOT flag); the repaired shape is the negative arm; defaulted output_format, sub_workflow descent, the three deliberate skips, compound conditions, and the operator-order parse are each pinned.

Dispatch wiring only (4 lines) — without it the binary falls through to the default report on the unrecognised flag (valid JSON, exit 0), which is the WFA-007 trap; the wrapper script also discriminates by output shape so an unwired mode cannot read as a pass.

The runnable form, mirroring audit-single-owner-actions.sh: identical live export (WalkSteps does the descent, the query must not), stderr not swallowed, refusal discriminated by EMPTY OUTPUT rather than the go-run-collapsed exit code. First live run against the fleet: 191 agents, 145 conditionals, 1 finding — internal-linker, the motivating case.
